div.div:
PPO Loop (RLinf Quickstart):
1. Rollout: policy generates trajectories in ManiSkill3
2. Compute rewards + advantages via GAE
3. Update policy with clipped surrogate objective
4. Sync updated weights to rollout model copy
Key: OpenVLA tokenizes actions as 256-bin discrete tokens
(same as language tokens). PPO operates on the token logits.
